name: Sliding Window
desc: Maintain a moving subarray to find optimal subarrays without recomputing from scratch.

name: Two Pointers
desc: Use two indices moving toward or away from each other to solve pair/subarray problems in linear time.

name: Fast & Slow Pointers
desc: Floyd's cycle detection — detect loops, find midpoints, and identify entry nodes in O(1) space.

name: Merge Intervals
desc: Sort intervals then merge overlapping ones — the backbone of scheduling and calendar problems.

name: Cyclic Sort
desc: Place each number at its correct index in one pass — ideal for missing/duplicate number problems.

name: In-place Reversal
desc: Reverse a linked list (or sublist) in place using pointer manipulation — no extra memory needed.

name: Tree BFS
desc: Level-order traversal using a queue — the key to zigzag, right-view, and level-average problems.

name: Tree DFS
desc: Pre/In/Post-order recursive traversal — covers path sums, diameter, and subtree queries.

name: Two Heaps
desc: Maintain a max-heap and min-heap to track the median of a sliding dataset in O(log N) per insert.

name: Subsets
desc: Generate all subsets, permutations, and combinations using BFS expansion or DFS backtracking.

name: Modified Binary Search
desc: Extend binary search for rotated arrays, infinite lists, and minimum/maximum constraint problems.

name: Top K Elements
desc: Maintain a size-K heap to find top-K frequent, largest, or closest elements without full sort.

name: K-way Merge
desc: Merge K sorted lists using a min-heap to always extract the global minimum in O(N log K).

name: Topological Sort
desc: Order nodes in a DAG respecting dependency constraints — core to build order and scheduling problems.

name: Prefix Sum
desc: Precompute cumulative sums to answer range queries in O(1) after O(N) preprocessing.

name: Monotonic Stack
desc: Maintain a monotonically increasing/decreasing stack to find next/previous greater elements in O(N).

name: Union Find
desc: Track connected components with near-constant union/find operations using path compression.

name: Dynamic Programming
desc: Break problems into overlapping subproblems and store results — covers 0/1 knapsack, LCS, and coin change.

name: Greedy
desc: Make the locally optimal choice at each step — works when a greedy choice leads to global optimum.

name: Bit Manipulation
desc: XOR, AND, OR, and bit shifts to solve low-level problems — single number, power of two, and more.
